scope: LOCAL_ONLY immutable image candidates, thumbnail comparison, structured image review, approval/rejection and keyframe derivation

FR-IMG-001.details: MediaService.import_file probes local IMAGE files, records immutable SHA-256/size/probe/source metadata and creates versioned MediaAsset/MediaVersion rows; verify_content_integrity marks tampering CORRUPT before reads or downstream use.

FR-IMG-002.details: GenerationWorkbench exposes explicit 1-8 take count and executes each take as an independent immutable Variant/Job with deterministic seed progression; seed-batch planning is bounded to 1-24 unique seeds and remains read-only until confirmation.

FR-IMG-003.details: Reviews view now exposes ImageCandidateGrid for bounded candidate overview plus ReviewInboxPanel A/B compare, reference pinning and keyboard navigation. The grid uses roving tabindex with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End selection and keeps focus on the selected candidate; the API also treats image/* MIME as an image safety fallback when media_kind is misclassified, so raw content remains blocked and the derived small thumbnail remains available.

FR-IMG-004.details: The immutable image_asset review template contains required identity, clothing, anatomy/hands, scene/props, composition, lighting, continuity and video-ready checks.

FR-IMG-005.details: ReviewService requires every required check, rejects approval when any check fails, requires a reason for REJECTED, persists reviewer/time/rule-template provenance and keeps approval separate from selection.

FR-IMG-006.details: Keyframe candidates are shot-owned immutable KEYFRAME versions with parent_version_id; selecting KEYFRAME only changes the selection pointer, while approval is an independently audited review decision and approval-impact propagation marks dependent continuity state stale.

required: Windows x64 three-viewport image review UAT
human screenshot/sign-off for grid and A/B compare

notes: Automated tests establish the immutable and negative-path contract. The evidence is intentionally not marked VERIFIED until production UAT uses user-owned local images and records the human review path. FR-IMG-007 has separate production UAT evidence.
